newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks expected to open lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks expected to open lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open lower on Tuesday amid investor anxiety ahead of economic data due this week and the November 5 U.S. presidential election.
Analysts said the third quarter employee cost index, due at 1330 GMT, would be closely watched for any indication of rising labour costs.
"You had a bad day yesterday, futures are lower and there is too much uncertainty for anyone to step up to the plate," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
